documents.title: Terms of Service
documents.intro: These terms govern access to BOUTIQUE, order placement, boutique inventory availability, and account obligations.

sections.heading: Store Access
body: BOUTIQUE publishes boutique inventory and delivery availability on a rolling basis. Availability can change before order confirmation if stock is exhausted or inventory is being reconciled.
Clients are responsible for maintaining accurate contact, address, and checkout details so order handling is not delayed.

sections.heading: Orders
body: Orders are only confirmed after payment authorization or cash-on-delivery validation is completed.
If an item becomes unavailable before confirmation, BOUTIQUE may cancel or partially adjust the order and notify the client through the app.

documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.intro: BOUTIQUE processes account, order, delivery, and support information to operate the marketplace and support the client relationship.

sections.heading: Data Usage
body: Profile, order, and address information is used to fulfill purchases, maintain account records, and support logistics operations.
Photos submitted for discovery features are used only to return styling results and improve the in-app experience.

sections.heading: Security
body: BOUTIQUE does not store raw card numbers in the mobile app or in backend order records.
Access to admin views and operational dashboards is limited to authorized staff accounts.

documents.title: Storefront Policy
documents.intro: This policy defines pricing display, delivery communication, and post-purchase support commitments across the storefront.

sections.heading: Pricing and Delivery
body: All prices are shown in EGP and delivery charges are surfaced before the final order step.
Cash-on-delivery fees and promo deductions are disclosed in the order summary before placement.

sections.heading: Support and Returns
body: Clients can use the support center or order detail screen for delivery questions, cancellations, and return requests where applicable.
Return acceptance depends on category, fulfillment status, and boutique policy.
